stories.title: What We Missed: Knicks Phishing Test Goes Out of Bounds

stories.title: “I couldn’t wait to step on the court in front of all of you”: emotional Alcaraz thanks the Paris crowd after missing Roland-Garros
stories.summary: Visibly moved during the trophy ceremony, Carlos Alcaraz ended his Rolex Paris Masters week with one last declaration of love to the Paris crowd, months after a wrist injury kept him away from Roland-Garros, where he has won twice.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.

entries.title: Someone is counter-programming launch day
